messages:
devon: Quick check — planning to flip the feature flag `batch_cache_v2` tomorrow, want to run a staggered canary across regions before a full enable. My proposal: start with 5% canary in us-west, wait 30m, if stable add 5% in eu-west, then ramp to 50% after another 30m. Need perf validation and a clear rollback hook. Who can own perf runs and the canary audience setup?

eli: I can run the microbench and smoke tests. Ping me the exact toggle commands and the perf harness invocation so I can reproduce locally and in the canary fleet.

devon: CLI for flags and a quick perf command below — will put this in the PR too:
```
ffctl set batch_cache_v2 on --audience=canary:5 --scope=us-west
# wait 30m
ffctl set batch_cache_v2 on --audience=canary:5 --scope=eu-west
# ramp: ffctl set batch_cache_v2 on --audience=50 --scope=global
```
Perf harness (run on a perf worker): `tools/perf/run_batch_harness --threads 64 --seq-dist=short --duration 600`
Expect ~8-12k tokens/s on our canary GPU pool depending on seq dist.

sam: Guardrails to confirm before any ramp: if `p95_latency_ms` increases >30% vs baseline for a sustained 5m window OR `error_rate_1m` > 1% then we should roll back immediately. Also watch `kv_cache_hit_ratio` — if it drops >15% that's a red flag. Add an automated rollback webhook to the flag service.

maria: I can create the canary audiences and own the rollout config. I'll wire the rollback action to the flag service and pre-seed a dashboard. Dashboard queries I'll use: 
``
# error rate
rate(request_errors[1m]) / rate(requests[1m])
# latency
p95_latency_ms
# cache health
kv_cache_hit_ratio
```
I'll also add CPU/memory alarms: cpu_util > 70% for 3m -> pager.

oncall-bot: Reminder: no feature flips during infra maintenance window 2026-03-18 09:00-11:00 PST.

devon: Good catch — let's not schedule inside that window. Can we target 02:00 UTC on 2026-03-19? Eli, can you run perf at 01:30 UTC and paste results in this thread? If green, we'll proceed with the staged rollout. I'll open the infra PR and link it here.

eli: Will run the harness at 01:30 UTC and post a short summary (p50/p95, error rate, cache hit ratio, GC pauses). I'll also tail kernel-level spikes and GCs for headroom.

maria: I'll pre-create the canary labels and the rollback-runbook (copy of standard rollback with our added kv_cache checks). I'll also configure the alert thresholds Sam suggested and set up an auto-rollback hook.

devon: PR -> https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/3247 (ops/flag flip + rollout doc). If anyone finds a regression we abort and run:
```
ffctl set batch_cache_v2 off --scope=global
```
I'll update the ops doc with timestamps and a short checklist before the flip. Thanks all — will follow up with a final schedule. :thumbsup:
